items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I know he had a group. He was here in Chicago. I didn't get to see him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's been working with Earl Hines. I heard him last year in California.
Yeah, yeah. And Darnell Howard. Oh, yes. I know he had a group. He was here in Chicago. I didn't get to see him.
Pops Foster. Did you ever work with him, the bass player?
